frame: robotX/robotY: robot live LiDAR frame, metres. floorX/floorY: the same point in the floorplan frame via tools/robot-survey/frames.json, a geometry-only fit of the robot map to the room polygons (never RSSI). Node x/y/z are floorplan metres.
headings: p* points (morning, 90 s) hold one heading. r*/s* points (evening resurvey, 30 s), q* (repeatability, 30 s) and g* (grid, 90 s) turn in place through the dwell; spinHeadingsDeg samples the headings covered. p* used a different beacon mount from the rest: the same spot reads ~9 dB rms apart across that remount, but within 1 dB on one mount.
rssi: m.<node>.rssi is the raw radio reading (published rssi + the node rxAdj at that moment), mean of n samples with sd. Nothing the live optimizer sets (rxAdj, rssi@1m, absorption, distance) is kept. The beacon is an ESPresense node at firmware defaults (rssi@1m -59 dBm).

expect.note: medianErrorM: ~25% above each locator's median on the 2026-10-24 approach fixture (17 spots, 40 visits, 2-3 arrival headings per spot, three first-floor rooms), distances at firmware defaults; one node had been moved ~1 m since the earlier fixtures. No throughStructureNodes: the triangle-inequality check flags none on this fixture.
